title: manufacturing.coa_edit input
description: specs/core row 12 (FM-09): one correction of a certificate image's lab data. `raw` holds only what the rule reads of the image's description: `keys` (which of subtype, psilocin, baeocystine, norbaeocystine, norpsilocin, aeruginascin and aeruginosin it has) and the value of `subtype`; `form` the typed text fields (a field not present is blank, `subtype` present or not matters); `uid` and `psilocybin` are the state's.
